definitions.explanation: Not paying attention to or caring about something, particularly appearance, manners, or details that others typically notice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{服装|ふくそう}→服装：03594_fukusou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{無頓着|むとんちゃく}だ。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{無頓着|むとんちゃく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{遅刻|ちこく}する→遅刻する：22282_chikokusuru⟧。
examples.english: He is careless about time and is always late.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{無頓着|むとんちゃく}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いれば→いる：00495_iru⟧、⟦こだわる→こだわる：10319_kodawaru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Some people are indifferent about food, while others are particular about it.

notes:
FORMS:
- Predicative: {無頓着|むとんちゃく}だ
- Modifier: {無頓着|むとんちゃく}な + noun

USAGE:
Almost always used with the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ to indicate what one is indifferent about: ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{無頓着|むとんちゃく}. Common topics include ⟦{服装|ふくそう}→服装：03594_fukusou⟧ (clothing), ⟦{身|み}だしなみ→身だしなみ：14286_midashinami⟧ (grooming), ⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧ (food), and ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (time).

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ (without) + {頓着|とんちゃく} (concern, care). {頓着|とんちゃく} alone is rarely used in modern Japanese.
